evidence: Home page showed 'Showing 8 jobs' matching 8 job cards; clicking a card navigated to /jobs/job-1 with full details.
job-1 detail page shows title, company, industry, employment type, location, salary, posted date, full description (responsibilities/requirements), and required skills matching the listing.

Job cards on home page display title, company, industry, employment type, location, salary range, posted date, and skills (e.g. job-1: Technology/Full-time/Senior Frontend Developer/TechCorp Solutions/San Francisco CA/$140k-$180k/Jan 15/React,TypeScript,CSS,Node.js).

Submitting empty application form blocked by native required validation ('Please fill out this field'); submitting with invalid email 'not-an-email' blocked with message identifying the email field as invalid ('Please include an @...'). No application was created in either case.

Submitted valid application (name, valid email, phone, message) on job-1; toast 'Application submitted! Your application for Senior Frontend Developer at TechCorp Solutions has been sent.' appeared, form cleared.

issue: Duplicate application with same email accepted instead of rejected
actual: Submitted a second application for job-1 using the same email 'test.applicant@example.com' as a prior application; the app showed a success toast and created a second distinct application record ('Test Applicant Duplicate') alongside the original ('Test Applicant') in the employer dashboard, instead of blocking it and leaving the original unchanged.

evidence: After submission, visible toast confirmation shown; application appeared under job-1 in employer dashboard with correct name/email/phone/message.

Employer dashboard application list for job-1 shows each application as a distinct record with name, email, optional phone (shown when provided, e.g. Alex Johnson 555-0101; omitted for entries without phone), message, and relative submission date (e.g. 'Jan 20', 'Yesterday').

issue: Newly submitted application date displayed as 'Yesterday' instead of 'Today'
actual: Browser system date/time confirmed as 2026-08-25T10:19 UTC (matches today's date). Two applications submitted at this exact time to job-1 are displayed with submission date 'Yesterday' in the employer dashboard, which is inaccurate relative to the current date.

evidence: Industry=Technology filtered to 2 jobs; adding Location=Seattle,WA narrowed to 1 job (job-7); adding Type=Full-time produced 0 results ('No jobs found'); Clear filters restored all 8 jobs.
Result count and list updated immediately after each filter/search change, including 'Showing 0 jobs'/'No jobs found' state; Clear filters restored full list of 8 with 'Showing 8 jobs'.

Search 'REACT' (uppercase) matched job-1 via skill 'React'; search 'techcorp' (lowercase) matched both jobs from company 'TechCorp Solutions'; search 'nurse' matched title 'Registered Nurse'. All updated result count immediately.

issue: Job posted successfully despite minimum salary exceeding maximum salary
actual: Submitted post-job form with all required fields filled but Minimum Salary=100000 and Maximum Salary=50000 (min > max). The app accepted it, showed 'Job posted successfully!' and created job 'QA Test Engineer' with salary range displayed as '$100k - $50k' in the employer dashboard, instead of rejecting it with feedback. (Separately confirmed: empty required fields and negative salary values ARE correctly blocked by native validation.)

evidence: Created 'Backend Engineer' job (Technology, Full-time, Chicago IL, $90k-$130k, description, skills Node.js/PostgreSQL). It appeared immediately in employer dashboard (6 active jobs, listed) and in job-seeker listing (Showing 9 jobs, card shown with all details).

Employer dashboard lists all 6 active jobs posted by 'Sarah Chen' employer (TechCorp Solutions jobs + others owned). Active Jobs stat = 6 matches list length; Total Applications stat = 3 matches sum of per-job application counts (2+1+0+0+0+0).

Clicking the applications toggle button on job-1 in the employer dashboard expanded an 'Applications (N)' panel listing the applications (name, email, message, date) associated specifically with that job.

issue: Published jobs and submitted applications do not persist across page reload
actual: Created job 'Backend Engineer' (visible in both employer dashboard and job-seeker list) and 2 applications on job-1; after reloading the page (full navigation to the app URL), the created job disappeared entirely (direct visit to its URL showed 'Job not found'), the job-seeker list reverted to the original 8 seed jobs, and the submitted applications reverted to only the original 2 seed applications for job-1. All state resets to the initial seed data on reload.

issue: No edit functionality exists for published jobs
actual: Inspected the employer dashboard (each job row only exposes an 'applications count' toggle and one icon-only action button) and the job detail page (/jobs/job-1, only shows a Back link and the application form) — no edit/update action, link, or form is present anywhere to modify a published job's details. Programmatic scan of all buttons/links on the dashboard confirmed only 'Post New Job', an applications-toggle button, and one unlabeled icon button (delete) per job row; no edit control exists.

evidence: Clicking delete on 'Marketing Manager' (job-4) opened confirmation dialog 'Delete this job? This will permanently delete...and all its applications.' Confirming removed it from employer dashboard (5→4 active jobs) and from job-seeker listing (8→7 jobs, job-4 no longer present).
